name: capa
description: Third-party APIs as proof-carrying Cloudflare service bindings.

scripts.typecheck: for capability in capabilities/*/; do NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=12288 bunx tsc --noEmit -p "$capability/tsconfig.json" || exit 1; done && bunx tsc --noEmit -p tests/harness/tsconfig.json
scripts.dry-run: for capability in capabilities/*/; do bunx wrangler deploy --dry-run -c "$capability/wrangler.jsonc" || exit 1; done && bunx wrangler deploy --dry-run -c tests/harness/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.check: bun run check:generated && bun run typecheck && bun run dry-run
